generic.Defined scope/population: All processes in the current inventory awaiting a criticality tier in the BIA workbook
generic.In-scope period: Current annual BIA cycle up to BCM Committee endorsement
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Tier, driving impact score, and rationale comment recorded for every process
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of tiered processes matches the confirmed process inventory total
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Tiering rationale and workbook export dated and saved in the BIA cycle folder
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Tier 1 processes lacking a named owner flagged and routed to the BCM Manager
generic.Test population: Sample of five Tier 1 and Tier 2 processes selected for rationale verification
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every process carries exactly one tier with a rationale citing a specific impact score
generic.Exception handling path: Unresolved owner gaps escalated to the Business Continuity Manager before committee
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Tiers reflect disruption impact assessment scores and pass BCM Committee review
generic.Evidence location: BIA workbook process inventory tab and BCM SharePoint cycle folder

steps.title: Pull the untiered process list from the BIA workbook
sop: Open the current-cycle BIA workbook in SharePoint and open the process inventory tab.
Filter the tab to processes with no criticality tier value set.
Done when the untiered process list is confirmed against the inventory total.
verify: Compare the filtered list count to the inventory tab's total row count.
Pass when the counts reconcile with no missing process IDs.

steps.title: Assign each process a Tier 1, Tier 2, or Tier 3 rating
sop: Open the disruption impact assessment for each process needing a tier.
Enter Tier 1 Critical, Tier 2 Important, or Tier 3 Standard in the workbook's tier column.
Done when every in-scope process carries a tier value based on its impact scores.
verify: Spot-check five tiered processes against their underlying impact scores.
Pass when each tier matches the scoring band for its impact score.

steps.title: Flag Tier 1 processes missing a named owner
sop: Filter the workbook to Tier 1 processes and check the process owner field.
Raise a flag record in the GRC platform for any Tier 1 process with a blank owner.
Done when every ownerless Tier 1 process has an open flag routed to the Manager.
verify: Query the GRC platform for open ownership flags against the Tier 1 list.
Pass when every ownerless Tier 1 process has a matching flag record.

steps.title: Record the tiering rationale in the process comments field
sop: Open each tiered process record in the BIA workbook.
Enter a rationale citing the specific impact score driving the tier in the comments field.
Done when every tiered process carries a documented rationale comment.
verify: Sample ten tiered processes and read their rationale comments.
Pass when every sampled rationale cites a specific impact score band.

steps.title: Circulate the tiered process list to the BCM Committee
sop: Export the finalized tiered process list from the BIA workbook.
Attach the export to the next scheduled BCM Committee agenda pack in SharePoint.
Done when the list is attached and the Business Continuity Manager is notified.
verify: Confirm the BCM Committee agenda pack contains the tiered list attachment.
Pass when the attachment is present and the notification is logged.

steps.title: Review the tiered list at the BCM Committee session
sop: Review the tiered process list at the scheduled BCM Committee session.
Record any committee-requested tier changes back into the BIA workbook.
Done when the committee review outcome is logged against the tiered list.
verify: Check the workbook for a recorded committee review date and any change entries.
Pass when the review date is recorded and no requested change is outstanding.

steps.title: Lock the tiered process list as the cycle's tiering of record
sop: Confirm all committee-requested changes are applied in the BIA workbook.
Mark the tiering tab as final for the cycle in the GRC platform.
Done when the tiered list is locked and dated as the approved tiering record.
verify: Reopen the workbook and confirm the tiering tab is locked against further edits.
Pass when every inventoried process has a documented tier with a rationale on file.

generic.Defined scope/population: All BIA findings for processes completing the current annual cycle
generic.In-scope period: Current BIA cycle through Risk Committee endorsement
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Process inventory, tiers, RTO/RPO targets, and gaps populated in the summary pack
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Top-10 highest-impact processes reconcile to the full quantified impact list

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Processes missing quantified impact data logged as gaps in the pack

steps.title: Assemble the BIA summary pack inputs
sop: Pull the process inventory, criticality tiers, RTO/RPO targets, and identified gaps from the BIA workbook.
Compile the inputs into the standard BIA summary pack template in SharePoint.
Done when all four input sections are populated in the draft pack.
verify: Check the draft pack for the four required sections.
Pass when process inventory, tiers, RTO/RPO, and gaps are all present.

steps.title: Attach the top-10 highest-impact process findings
sop: Rank processes by the quantified impact score recorded in the BIA workbook.
Attach the top-10 findings with supporting quantification to the summary pack.
Done when the top-10 section is attached with supporting figures.
verify: Cross-check the attached top-10 list against the ranked impact scores.
Pass when the ten highest-scoring processes are the ones attached.

steps.title: Add the BCP development recommendations section
sop: List the BCP development priorities arising from the BIA gaps identified.
Add the recommendations section to the summary pack.
Done when recommendations are drafted for every identified gap.
verify: Review the recommendations section against the logged gaps.
Pass when every logged gap has a corresponding recommendation.

steps.title: Route the pack to the Risk Committee secretariat
sop: Finalize the summary pack and confirm the meeting date from the board portal calendar.
Send the pack to the Risk Committee secretariat at least 5 business days ahead.
Done when the secretariat confirms receipt within the notice window.
verify: Check the board portal for the secretariat's receipt confirmation.
Pass when receipt is confirmed at least 5 business days before the meeting.

steps.title: Present the BIA pack at the Risk Committee meeting
sop: Present the summary pack findings and recommendations to the Risk Committee.
Capture the committee's questions and any requested changes.
Done when the committee reaches an endorsement decision or defers with conditions.
verify: Confirm the meeting minutes record an explicit committee decision.
Pass when the decision is documented as endorsed, deferred, or rejected.

steps.title: Log the endorsement decision back into the BIA record
sop: Retrieve the committee's decision and any conditions from the board portal minutes.
Record the decision and conditions in the BIA cycle record in the GRC platform.
Done when the decision is logged against the cycle record.
verify: Open the GRC platform BIA cycle record and check for the logged decision.
Pass when the decision and any conditions are recorded with the meeting date.

steps.title: File the endorsed pack and close the cycle record
sop: Save the final endorsed pack version to the BIA cycle folder in SharePoint.
Update the cycle record status to Endorsed once conditions are cleared.
Done when the endorsed pack is filed and the cycle status is updated.
verify: Open the cycle folder and confirm the endorsed pack version is present.
Pass when the cycle status shows Endorsed with the pack attached.

steps.title: Define the RTO/RPO data-collection questionnaire

verify: Check the questionnaire covers RTO, RPO, and dependency fields.

steps.title: Set the cycle timeline with milestone dates
sop: Set milestone dates for data collection, validation, and committee endorsement.
Enter the milestone dates into the methodology document's timeline section.

verify: Review the timeline section for all three milestone dates.
Pass when each milestone has a date that precedes the next milestone.

steps.title: Circulate the draft methodology document for review
sop: Route the draft scope and methodology document to the Business Continuity Manager and Operational Resilience Analyst.

verify: Check the document's comment history for reviewer sign-off or comments.

steps.title: Obtain Business Continuity Manager sign-off
sop: Review the finalized scope and methodology document for completeness.
Sign off the document in the GRC platform methodology record.

Pass when the sign-off date precedes the data-collection start date.

steps.title: Publish the approved document to business units
sop: Publish the signed scope and methodology document to the BCM SharePoint site.
Notify business unit BCM coordinators that the document is published.
Done when the document is published and coordinators are notified.
verify: Confirm the SharePoint site shows the current approved version.
Pass when the effective date is ahead of the data-collection start date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every critical process identified in the current BIA cycle

steps.title: Record the RTO for each critical process
sop: Open the BIA workbook's RTO/RPO tab for the critical process list.
Enter the Recovery Time Objective for each critical process based on business tolerance.
Done when every critical process has an RTO value recorded.
verify: Check the tab for a populated RTO cell against every critical process row.
Pass when no critical process row has a blank RTO.

steps.title: Record the RPO referencing supporting systems
sop: Identify the supporting systems for each critical process from the application catalog.
Enter the Recovery Point Objective referencing the supporting system in the workbook.
Done when every critical process has an RPO linked to its supporting system.
verify: Confirm each RPO entry references a named supporting system.
Pass when every critical process row has a system-linked RPO value.

steps.title: Record the Maximum Tolerable Period of Disruption
sop: Enter the MTPD for each critical process in the workbook.
Confirm the MTPD value exceeds the recorded RTO for the same process.
Done when every process has an MTPD greater than its RTO.
verify: Compare MTPD against RTO for each critical process row.
Pass when MTPD is greater than RTO for every row.

steps.title: Cross-check RTOs against the IT DR runbook capability
sop: Open the corresponding IT DR runbook for each critical process's supporting system.
Compare the runbook's demonstrated recovery time against the process's requested RTO.
Done when every RTO has a matching DR runbook capability check.
verify: Review the cross-check log for a capability comparison per process.
Pass when every process shows a recorded DR capability comparison outcome.

steps.title: Flag processes where RTO exceeds current DR capability
sop: Identify processes where the requested RTO cannot be met by the current DR runbook.
Raise an escalation record in the GRC platform for each shortfall.
Done when every capability shortfall has an open escalation record.
verify: Query the GRC platform for open RTO capability escalations.
Pass when every identified shortfall has a matching escalation record.

steps.title: Resolve or accept flagged RTO shortfalls
sop: Review each open RTO shortfall escalation with the Business Continuity Analyst.
Record the resolution as a capability investment plan or an accepted risk.
Done when every shortfall escalation has a recorded disposition.
verify: Check each escalation record for a disposition entry.
Pass when every shortfall shows a resolution or an accepted-risk note.

steps.title: Publish the finalized RTO/RPO/MTPD values
sop: Confirm all cross-checks and dispositions are recorded in the workbook.
Publish the finalized RTO/RPO/MTPD tab for use in BCP development.
Done when the tab is published with no outstanding unresolved flags.
verify: Reopen the published tab and check for unresolved flag markers.
Pass when every critical process shows finalized, consistent values.

steps.title: Load endorsed BIA results into the BCM system
sop: Open the BCM system's process criticality module.
Load the committee-endorsed tier, RTO, RPO, and MTPD values for each process.

verify: Count the loaded records against the endorsed source pack.
Pass when the counts match with no missing process.

steps.title: Confirm each record carries its dependency mapping
sop: Cross-check each loaded process record against its dependency map.
Add any missing system, third-party, or physical dependency to the record.
Done when every process record shows a complete dependency mapping.
verify: Sample five process records for dependency completeness.
Pass when each sampled record has system, vendor, and site dependencies.

steps.title: Attach the endorsement minutes as supporting evidence
sop: Retrieve the Risk Committee endorsement minutes from the board portal.
Attach the minutes to the BIA cycle record in the compliance evidence repository.
Done when the minutes are attached to the cycle record.
verify: Open the cycle record and confirm the minutes attachment is present.
Pass when the attached minutes match the correct meeting date.

steps.title: Lock the cycle record to prevent further edits
sop: Confirm all process records and evidence are complete for the cycle.
Set the cycle record status to Locked in the BCM system.
Done when the lock is applied and edit permissions are removed.
verify: Attempt to open a locked record for edit access.
Pass when the system blocks further edits to the locked cycle.

steps.title: Notify business unit BCM coordinators of the system of record
sop: Prepare a notification listing the cycle's locked status and system location.
Send the notification to all affected business unit BCM coordinators.
Done when every affected coordinator has received the notification.
verify: Check the notification log for delivery to each coordinator.
Pass when every affected coordinator shows a delivered notification.

steps.title: Run a completeness check across all loaded records
sop: Query the BCM system for any process record missing a required field.
Log any incomplete record for correction before the cycle is reported closed.
Done when the completeness query returns zero missing fields.
verify: Rerun the completeness query after any corrections.
Pass when zero process records show a missing required field.

steps.title: Confirm the cycle closure with the Business Continuity Manager
sop: Review the completeness check results and the locked record count.
Confirm the cycle as closed in the BCM system's cycle tracker.
Done when the cycle tracker shows a closed status with the closure date.
verify: Open the cycle tracker and check the status and closure date.
Pass when the status reads Closed with all records locked and evidenced.

steps.title: Schedule BIA discovery workshops with business unit leads
sop: Pull the confirmed business unit lead list from the BCM coordinator register.
Send workshop invitations with the BIA discovery agenda to each lead.

steps.title: Capture critical services during the workshop
sop: Run the workshop and record each critical service the business unit identifies.

verify: Review the workshop notes for named services with descriptions.
Pass when every listed service has both a name and a description.

steps.title: Record upstream and downstream service dependencies
sop: Ask the business unit lead to state each service's upstream and downstream dependencies.
Record the stated dependencies against the service entry in the workshop notes.
Done when every captured service has its dependencies recorded.
verify: Check each service entry for recorded upstream and downstream dependencies.
Pass when every service entry lists at least one dependency or none if stated.

steps.title: Confirm the business unit lead agrees with the captured list
sop: Read back the captured service list to the business unit lead before closing.
Note any correction the lead requests and update the list.
Done when the lead has verbally or in writing confirmed the list.
verify: Check the workshop notes for a recorded lead confirmation.

steps.title: File workshop notes and the confirmed service list
sop: Save the workshop notes and confirmed service list to the business unit's BIA folder.
Name the file using the business unit and cycle date convention.
Done when the file is saved in the correct SharePoint folder.
verify: Open the business unit's BIA folder and confirm the file is present.
Pass when the file name matches the naming convention and cycle date.

steps.title: Escalate unresponsive business units
sop: Identify any business unit lead who has not scheduled or completed a workshop.
Escalate the non-response to the Business Continuity Manager with the outstanding date.
Done when every non-responder has a logged escalation.
verify: Check the GRC platform for escalation records against non-responders.
Pass when every non-responding business unit has an open escalation record.

steps.title: Reconcile confirmed service lists against the coordinator register
sop: Compile the confirmed service lists from every completed workshop.
Cross-check the compiled list against the full BCM coordinator register.
Done when every in-scope business unit shows a confirmed service list.
verify: Count confirmed lists against the coordinator register total.

verify: Review the resource tab for data feed and staleness entries.

steps.title: Record minimum premises or workspace requirements

steps.title: Confirm third-party resource dependencies are captured

Done when every third-party-supported resource has a vendor register link.
verify: Spot-check three third-party-supported resources for a register link.
Pass when each spot-checked resource links to a valid vendor register entry.

steps.title: Route the completed entry to the process owner for sign-off
sop: Compile the completed staff, systems, data, and premises minimums for the process.
Route the compiled entry to the process owner for review and sign-off.
Done when the process owner has reviewed the compiled entry.
verify: Check the workbook for a process owner review status per entry.

steps.title: Confirm sign-off is recorded for every critical process
sop: Collect the process owner's sign-off for each minimum resource requirement entry.
Update the resource tab with the sign-off date and name.
Done when every critical process entry shows a recorded sign-off.

Pass when zero critical process entries are missing a sign-off.
